besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Bone ... bou' and 'melk en vis doen').
'die krag' is vague and 'vir speel' is colloquial.
besluite.rede: 'gee jou krag ... om te speel' is natural Afrikaans and says the same thing.

besluite.fout: 'Groente en vrugte elke dag help' leaves 'elke dag' dangling after the subject, so the reader stumbles.
besluite.rede: The relative clause attaches 'elke dag' clearly without adding any new content.
'dors word' is ordinary, natural Afrikaans, so swapping it for 'dors kry' changes nothing that matters.

besluite.fout: 'gesonde eet' copies English 'healthy eating'; with the infinitive Afrikaans uses the adverb.
besluite.rede: 'oor gesond eet' is the correct Afrikaans form with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: 'deel wees van' follows English 'be part of' word order.
besluite.rede: Standard Afrikaans order with 'wees' at the end; the protected 'die meeste' stays intact.

besluite.fout: 'en oor hoeveel daarvan' is clipped and has no verb.
besluite.rede: The complete parallel reads more easily and keeps the meaning.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma between two full clauses.
besluite.rede: The comma is required, and 'jy' matches how the paragraph addresses the reader without changing the claim.

besluite.fout: 'is wel joune om self te kies' is a wooden copy of English 'yours to choose'.
besluite.rede: 'kan jy wel self kies' is natural Afrikaans with the same meaning.

besluite.fout: 'heeldag lank deur' stacks two time expressions awkwardly.
besluite.rede: 'die hele dag deur' is the natural fixed form and means the same.

besluite.fout: 'wat krag gee' can be read as describing only 'aartappels' instead of 'Kos'.
besluite.rede: This is a real ambiguity, but it sits in a shared glossary definition, so only the writer may reword it.
'Klein plat sade' reads fine without the comma, and it is a shared glossary definition.
'suur melk' works as one unit with 'dik' describing it, so the adjectives are not coordinate and need no comma; it is also a shared glossary definition.

besluite.fout: 'jou dit meestal wil laat koop' stacks the pronouns and verbs and is hard to read at Grade 5.
besluite.rede: This is a real fault, but it is a shared glossary definition, and 'oorhaal' (persuade) moves the meaning, so it needs the writer.
